findings.evidence: roadmap/EpsilonEridaniRoadmaps/SpinStructure/README.md §0.2: 'the space of alternating bilinear forms on `V` that are conserved in both slots and linear in `S` is exactly two dimensional'.
findings.fix: Restate as the roadmap does: the alternating, both-slot-conserved, *S-linear* forms are two-dimensional under linear independence of p, q, S and Q² ≠ 0; mention the excluded candidate ε(·,·,p,S).
findings.issue: False mathematical claim in the module docstring: 'Together they span the space of alternating bilinear forms that vanish on `q`. In four dimensions this space is two-dimensional.' For dim V = 4 and q ≠ 0, that space is Λ²(V/⟨q⟩)* of dimension 3 (Λ²V* has dim 6; ω ↦ ω(q,·) surjects onto the 3-dimensional annihilator of q, so the kernel is 6−3 = 3). Two-dimensionality holds only after also imposing S-linearity, and spanning additionally needs p, q, S independent — if S ∈ span q then E₁ = 0.
